Container.Name: Beamfall Core
Container.Overview: Beamfall Core media server. Media mounts are read-only. Before a release digest is published, build the image locally and override Repository: see packaging/unraid/README.md in the source repository. Icon and CA metadata are placeholders until branding assets are published.

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Beamfall server state and SQLite databases. Prefer a pool path such as /mnt/cache/appdata/... over the FUSE /mnt/user path: SQLite locking and fsync are slower and less reliable through FUSE.

Config.Name: Media Directory
Config.Description: Read-only media mount. Library roots are container paths, so mounting a share at the same path it has on the host (for example host /mnt/user/movies at container /mnt/user/movies) keeps roots identical to Unraid share paths and to other media servers. Add one Path per share, always read-only, then add Library roots from the Beamfall Console.

Config.Name: Transcode Scratch
Config.Description: HLS and transcode scratch, used when BEAMFALL_TRANSCODE_TMP points at /transcode. Put it on a fast pool; it is safe to clear while the container is stopped.

Config.Name: Intel QSV/VAAPI Device
Config.Description: Optional: enable Intel QSV/VAAPI passthrough by setting this to /dev/dri. Leave blank for CPU-only.

Config.Name: Address
Config.Description: Beamfall listen address inside the container.

Config.Name: Data Dir Env
Config.Description: Beamfall data directory inside the container.

Config.Name: Transcode Tmp
Config.Description: HLS and transcode scratch directory inside the container. Keep it on the Transcode Scratch mount.

Config.Name: Known Proxies
Config.Description: Set to your reverse proxy's address or CIDR when one fronts this container (nginx, Traefik, a Caddy sidecar, Unraid's built-in reverse proxy…). Leave blank when the Web UI port is reached directly. Without this set, the server refuses to treat any relayed request as LAN, so a fronting proxy's clients would otherwise fail the pairing LAN gate.
